Second SILEX requirements follow-up meeting to review the updated catalogue of municipal procedures, the sources received from Santa Marina and the fields still outstanding before the mappings can be stabilized.

Javier Ortega: Let us begin with the updated catalogue. Alba, how many procedures now meet the minimum requirements?
Alba Prieto: We have 58 complete procedures out of 62. The four outstanding procedures concern resident registration and require clarification of the deadline, responsible unit and legal basis.
Luis Noguera: The registration unit has reviewed the records, but it has not yet authorized reuse of the complete dataset. We can provide an anonymized sample this week.
Sergio Vidal: The sample would be sufficient to validate the structure, but not to close the final mapping or test pilot coverage.
Clara Ibáñez: Does this affect deliverable D3 or only deployment?
Alba Prieto: The deliverable can be closed if the limitation is recorded, although the mapping catalogue will remain incomplete until we receive the authorization and the four corrected records.
Javier Ortega: Agreed. We will keep the issue as an open dependency. Luis will send the anonymized sample on 18 March and confirm the legal-review schedule before the 25th.
Luis Noguera: Confirmed.
Javier Ortega: Alba will update the catalogue with the status of each field, and Sergio will prepare a partial validation for the next session.
